newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 664 retail money market mutual funds rose $4.46 billion to $600.29 billion in the week ended November 6, the Investment Company Institute, an industry trade group, said Thursday.
It said assets of the 405 taxable money market funds in the retail category rose $2.91 billion to $489.40 billion, while assets of the 259 tax-exempt funds rose $1.55 billion to $110.89 billion.

The trade group said assets of the 312 institutional money market funds rose $2.29 billion to $285.19 billion. Of these, the 248 taxable money market fund assets grew $1.05 billion to $255.41 billion, and assets of the 64 tax exempt funds rose $1.24 billion to $29.78 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $885.48 billion in the week. Assets for the week ended October 30 were revised to $878.74 billion from $878.48 billion.
